ignored_sender_ids.description: 忽略发送者 QQ 号
ignored_sender_ids.hint: 名单中的账号发出的所有消息都会在 AstrBot 全局入口被忽略，适合填写群内其他机器人的 QQ 号。

ignored_commands.description: Exact command words reserved for NoneBot
ignored_commands.hint: Comma or newline separated. AstrBot will stop handling messages whose first line is exactly one of these commands, or begins with one of them followed by arguments.

ignored_prefixes.hint: Comma or newline separated. Leave empty unless a future NoneBot plugin owns a whole command prefix.
